title: REQ · Maximum length is enforced with a visible character counter and inline message
summary: Enforce a max prompt length with counter and message
description: Context: the textarea has no limit while the backend rejects prompts over 500 characters. Desired behavior: a counter shows used/max, and over-limit text shows an inline message and disables Send. Expected result: over-limit prompts are never submitted. Why: avoid avoidable server rejections.
acceptance_criteria: Given the textarea holds N characters, then a counter reads 'N/500'
Given the trimmed text exceeds 500 characters, then an inline message 'Idea is too long' is shown and Send is disabled
Given the text is exactly 500 characters, then Send is enabled and no length message is shown

out_of_scope: Reading the limit from the backend

technical_constraints: Constant lives in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts beside MAX_PER_PLAYER
